people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
translations.bsb: But Peter helped him up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
translations.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
